description: Resolve country, region, autonomous-system, or geoasn (one ASN within a region or country) names and codes for outage investigations. Choose entityType and either query or entityCode; omit both to list the type. Countries use two letters, regions numeric IODA codes, ASNs decimal digits (AS prefix accepted), geoasns an ASN and a region or country code (40934-576, 59962-IR). Add relatedToType and relatedToCode to list entityType entities within one country, region, ASN, or geoasn, such as the regions or networks of a country; a scope combines with query. Metadata does not establish measurement coverage. Pages are zero-based; keep limit fixed when continuing.

entityCode.description: Two-letter country code, IODA numeric region code, decimal ASN (AS prefix accepted), or geoasn code joining an ASN and a region or country code (40934-576, 59962-IR); resolve names with ioda_search_entities and pass a returned code here.

entityType.description: country, region, asn, or geoasn (one ASN within a region or country); whitespace and case are normalized.

limit.description: Upstream page size; values above 100 are served as 100 with a notice. Keep fixed when continuing.

page.description: Zero-based upstream page; restart at 0 when changing limit.

query.description: Name substring, trimmed to at most 200 UTF-16 code units; blank is omitted. Mutually exclusive with entityCode.

relatedToCode.description: Scope entity code, normalized like entityCode for relatedToType (IR, 1829, AS42337, 60627-IR); resolve names with ioda_search_entities. Provide with relatedToType.

relatedToType.description: Scope type: country, region, asn, or geoasn. With relatedToCode, returns entityType entities related to that entity, such as the regions or networks of one country. Requires entityType and excludes entityCode; blank is omitted. Outage membership coverage is unverified independently of row pagination; page ioda_search_entities and query selected codes individually.

name: ioda_search_entities

applied.description: Every normalized input, effective window, filter and pagination value.

entities.description: Original entity metadata; not measurement coverage.

items.description: Entity metadata with unmodified source attributes

subnames.description: Additional source names, preserved verbatim: usually a list; geoasn search rows carry named parts such as asn and region or country

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_entity`: entityCode is incompatible with entityType, zero or out of range. `conflicting_search`: Both query and entityCode were provided. `invalid_scope`: relatedToType and relatedToCode are incomplete or incompatible, the code is zero or out of range, or a scope comes with entityCode. `upstream_bad_request`: IODA rejects the request with HTTP 400 or an error envelope. `upstream_unprocessable`: IODA rejects the request with HTTP 422. `entity_not_found`: IODA returns an explicit entity 404. `upstream_rate_limited`: IODA returns HTTP 429. `upstream_queue_full`: The shared request queue is full. `upstream_schema`: IODA data or bucket metadata does not validate. `response_too_large`: The upstream body or combined response exceeds its byte budget. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Result interpretation and concrete next call.

more.description: Whether another row page may exist; no does not verify related-scope membership coverage

nextPage.description: Next page when another may exist and IODA can continue the request; absent from a full page it cannot continue, whose notice names the route to the rest

endpoint.description: Fixed HTTPS IODA upstream endpoint URL

truncated.description: A full page may have further records; not an exact total.
